You can use the Vector Store to find info, which contains all pages of Notion (intranet) with internal knowledge.

You can also run SQL queries for quantitive questions on tables. To execute an SQL query: send the query to Peliqan tool "Execute SQL" in a key SQL_Query__View_. Get the results from key "detail".

parameters.content:
## ℹ️ Introduction

End-to-end demo of a chatbot using business data from multiple sources (e.g. Notion, Chargebee, Hubspot etc.) with RAG + SQL.

Peliqan.io is used as a "cache" of all business data. Peliqan uses one-click ELT to sync all your business data to its built-in data warehouse, allowing for fast & accurate RAG and "Text to SQL" queries.

## ⚙️ Setup

* Sign up for a free trial on peliqan.io.
* Add one or more sources in Peliqan (e.g. Hubspot, Pipedrive...)
* Copy your Peliqan API key under settings and use it here to add a Peliqan connection
* Run the Vectorize pipeline in Peliqan to create vectors (embeddings) for RAG.
* Update the list of tables & columns that can be used for SQL in the System Message of the AI Agent.

Visit peliqan.io/n8n for more information.

⚠️ To use the Peliqan as tool with Operation "Execute SQL query":
set the below env variable. Run on command line:
`export N8N_COMMUNITY_PACKAGES_ALLOW_TOOL_USAGE=True`
## Tools for AI Agent: SQL & RAG

## Feed data into the Vector Store (for RAG)

This is done in Peliqan using the Vectorize pipeline.
Example script (double click this sticky note to see full source code):

```
import openai
import json
dbconn = pq.dbconnect(pq.DW_NAME)

openai.api_key = pq.get_secret("OpenAI API key") # Add a secret store under Connections with your OpenAI API key
EMBED_MODEL = "text-embedding-3-large"  # or text-embedding-3-small (dimension: 1536)
EMBED_MODEL_DIMENSION = 3072

def get_embedding(text: str) -> list[float]:
    resp = openai.embeddings.create(model=EMBED_MODEL, input=text)
    return resp.data[0].embedding

def create_table():
    query_create_extension = "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector"
    dbconn.execute(pq.DW_NAME, query = query_create_extension)
    
    query_create_table = f"""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rag.documents (
            id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
            text TEXT,
            metadata JSONB, 
            embedding vector({EMBED_MODEL_DIMENSION})
        )
    """
    dbconn.execute(pq.DW_NAME, query = query_create_table)

def vectorize():
    create_table()
    
    # replace this, get records from source table in Peliqan DWH (e.g. Notion pages)
    records = [
        {"id": 1, "text": "Hello world"},
        {"id": 2, "text": "OpenAI makes embeddings easy"},
        {"id": 3, "text": "Postgres with pgvector is powerful"},
    ]
    
    for record in records:
        source_id = record["id"]
        st.write(f"Vectorizing source id {source_id}")
        embedding = get_embedding(record["text"])
        metadata = { 
            "source_id": source_id
        }

        text_str = record["text"].replace('\'','\'\'')
        metadata_str = json.dumps(metadata).replace("'", "''")   # escape single quotes
        embedding_str = "[" + ",".join(f"{x:.6f}" for x in embedding) + "]"  # compact vector

        query_remove_existing_vector = f"DELETE FROM rag.documents WHERE metadata ->> 'source_id' = '{source_id}';"
        result = dbconn.execute(pq.DW_NAME, query = query_remove_existing_vector)
        if result.get("status") != "success":
            st.write(result)
        
        query_insert = f"INSERT INTO rag.documents (text, metadata, embedding) VALUES ('%s', '%s', '%s');" % (text_str, metadata_str, embedding_str)
        result = dbconn.execute(pq.DW_NAME, query = query_insert)
        if result.get("status") != "success":
            st.write(result)

vectorize()
```
